title.zh: 汤本到强罗：看懂登山电车的上升
title.ja: 湯本から強羅へ：登山電車の上り方を読む
title.en: Yumoto to Gora: Read the Mountain Railway's Climb

sources.use: Route length, approximate duration, station order, and three switchback locations
Maximum grade, minimum curve radius, adhesion design, and switchback history
Published station elevations only; seasonal status discarded

generalizations: The horizontal axis shows station order, not distance or running time
The vertical profile uses published station elevations; the line between stations is schematic
Switchback marker positions show sequence only; no unlisted signal-station elevation is implied
About 40 minutes is a checked operator approximation, not a timetable guarantee
Museum and cable-car callouts are planning decisions, not connection promises
